mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.employee_id AS employeeId, e.real_name AS employeeName, u.enabled
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = u.employee_id

where.if: AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT code, name FROM sys_role ORDER BY code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password_hash, display_name, employee_id, enabled) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{employeeId}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
